text:
Hermes Agent natively supports Raspberry Pi / ARM64 environments. Multi-architecture Docker images (`linux/arm64` and `linux/amd64`) are natively published. 

If you are running small local models (4B–9B) on the Raspberry Pi, you can optimize performance by:
- Disabling unused toolsets using `hermes tools` (reducing prompt/token overhead from schemas).
- Setting `terminal.backend: local` in your configuration.
- Applying faster quantizations.
